scope: Complete structural, canonical ownership, bilingual field and registered reference audit of 150 questions. Prior bounded original-passage evidence reconciled by version; NOT newly performed full claim-by-claim original-text certification.

findings.issue: A separate Ephesians5 review test still asserted the obsolete bespoke five-stage schema after the live app migrated to the standard eight stages.
findings.resolution: Test updated to enforce shared stage labels, bilingual evidence and current canonical owner mapping.

findings.issue: CSE045 repeated substantially the same engagement and marital-coercion discussions already owned by CSE032 and CSE054.
findings.resolution: Remove duplicated MAR-06 and MAR-07 subdebates; link from CSE045 to the existing question owners, keep their original public IDs and CSE054 full debate.

findings.issue: CSE045 search still indexed deleted 5-stage property names and missed most current eight-stage text.
findings.resolution: Search now indexes Object.keys(DEBATE_LABELS) instead of obsolete properties.

findings.issue: A few learner-visible CSE054 and practical-sexual-ethics phrases spoke about how to write an answer instead of stating the Catholic argument.
findings.resolution: Two concrete bilingual editorial-text repairs in existing principal debate fields.

findings.issue: The older short-answer source ledger reported 23 unchecked cases, but two confirmations and a later 21-case bounded source pass resolved that count. This did not certify full question claims.
findings.resolution: Report distinguishes 95 bounded original paragraph scope checks from zero fully certified answers; leaves independent French/theological approval open.

findings.issue: The headship / mutual submission texts do not use identical language: Casti Connubii §§26–29 asserts domestic primacy; Mulieris Dignitatem §24 states mutual subjection. The precise reconciliation and concrete authority claims need independent theological assessment.
findings.resolution: No invented theological signoff. Preserve primary-source citations, challenge both sides accurately, mark claim-level certification outstanding.

findings.issue: Existing 55-debate certification audit identifies partial original-proponent attribution risks and records zero full stage-by-stage primary passage certification.
findings.resolution: Retain original-opponent validation gates. Do not infer original author endorsement merely from source presence.
